notes.title: General Update (Aug 2025)
notes.content:
[h3][b]🎉 Game developing progress![/b][/h3][p]It’s been a little while since I shared the first Alpha and playtest versions of the game, and I’ve been quietly working on monthly updates, polishing features, and listening closely to your feedback. This update is a little reflection on where the game is currently now and where it's heading![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/e84640f96080e67bc6b8b1ced1d443488ceb8204.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]☕️ Looking Back: The First Alpha Milestone[/b][/h3][p]The very first Alpha release launched with the foundation of what will be Tailside’s Early Access experience. Here's what was already up and running back then:[/p][p][/p][p]🟢 Expanded different drink recipes: [b]8/8 COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Expanded decor: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Village (NPC) customers: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Day and night cycle: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Bedroom area: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Accessibility: Missing Day & Night cycle length setting [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Save & Load system: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Controller support: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]
[b]Since that release,[/b] these features have continued to evolve, improving based on your playtest feedback. From polish and visual clarity to control and comfort, everyone's input has shaped every corner of the experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]☕️ Growing Beyond the Plan[/b][/h3][p]As development progressed, Tailside expanded far beyond its original scope. New features, many not part of the original roadmap, have found their way into the game, more than doubling the planned content:

🟢 Skill Tree: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Custom Character Import: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Shop & Delivery System: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Brewing and Cafe upgrades: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Newspaper storyline: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Journal: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p]🟢 Pastry buying & selling: [b]COMPLETED[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Some of these were born from spontaneous inspiration, others from cozy community suggestions and I'm happy the alpha testers have been enjoying them so far as well![/p][p][/p][h3][b]☕️ Next update content[/b][/h3][p]It seems that since last alpha update, there's not that much issues to fix, so I have been already working towards next update this week with new things while another dev is helping fix up some issues around:

🟢 Mini storyline chapters through newspaper making the game feel somewhat like having a start and end[/p][p]🟢 Characters will have speech bubble reactions in general once approached and also reactions to current day's newspaper[/p][p]🟢 Terrace area preview[/p][p]🟢 UI adjusted to controller displays instead of only keyboard/mouse so all the players with controllers can have proper instructions[/p][p]🔴 And then the last thing that is missing now before the next update would be some gameplay adjustments to match the newspaper and terrace additions so it actually makes sense in the game haha and of course some retesting to make sure it's all playable.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/d57e391d203d1ec3f1dd8b8d92e39d4319886ee0.gif"][/img]
[/p][h3][b]☕️ Debut Festival 2025: August 7–11[/b][/h3][p]Tailside will be part of a special Steam festival event [b]"Debut Festival 2025" from August 7–11![/b] This event features various game developers that are debutting their first games. During the time of this festival, Tailside Demo together with the Sandbox Playtest will be available to play.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]☕️ Thank You for Being Here[/b][/h3][p]Whether you played the Alpha, shared a kind word, wishlisted, or just quietly followed along, thank you. Your support means the world to this small café in the woods.[/p][p]

[b]If you would like to be part of the development journey,[/b] you can vote on various ideas on:
[url="https://discord.com/invite/3Q9WJ2V7bA"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://x.com/CoffeeBeansDev"]Twitter[/url] | [url="https://www.instagram.com/coffeebeansdev/"]Instagram[/url] | [url="https://forms.gle/56vRkPBoaJ1Vshuh7"]Leave your own suggestions[/url]
[i]Thank you so much for the support[/i] [b]- Coffee Beans Dev[/b][/p]

notes.title: Alpha V 0.12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b][h3]Notes:[/h3][/b]
This update mostly focuses on a few known alpha bugs and on the build (decor) mode system as it’s a big part of the game, I want to ensure it’s enjoyable.

[b][h3]Alpha 0.1.2 Update & Fixes[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed tips timer appearing when there is no order.
[*] Fixed cafe counters not appearing in build mode inventory when in the bedroom (buttons remain disabled since cafe counters only exist in the cafe).
[*] Fixed ordered items not showing up in inventory.
[*] Added new NPC appearances as you progress through the days in the game.
[*] Added a few new newspaper issues with hints about the new NPCs.
[*] Fixed floors, wallpapers, and cafe counters appearing in the shop even after being purchased.
[*] Added a missing panel slider in the shop orders panel.
[*] Added a missing panel slider in the shop sell panel.
[*] Fixed the ability to claim multiple items from orders when clicking rapidly.
[*] Added additional safeguards to the cleaning bar system.
[*] Slightly reduced NPC customer chance to better balance NPC and creature appearances in the cafe.
[*] Improved tab visibility for the shop and journal panels.
[*] Added instructional UI for opening/closing the cafe to reduce confusion at the start of a new day.
[*] Added a note on the cafe’s glass door hinting at future updates.
[*] You can now turn on the fireplace in your bedroom.
[/list]

[b][h3]Build mode and Sandbox improvements:[/h3][/b] (Included in Playtest version)
[list]
[*] Saving/loading items on tables should now work correctly and no longer place them behind.
[*] Saving/loading of floor and wallpaper designs should now be fixed.
[*] Fixed items on tables loading in incorrect positions and layers.
[*] Added item categories.
[*] Added the ability to enable/disable the build mode inventory to avoid blocking the view while placing items.
[*] Added the ability to continue placing the same item without needing to reselect it each time.
[*] Added the ability to flip certain items (such as plants and some others).
[*] The small calendar can now be placed on walls.
[*] You can now decorate the middle wall with the staircase door.
[*] An indication for rotate/flip functionality is now shown when available for selected items.
[*] Chairs should no longer glitch through the middle wall.
[*] Restored the ability to decorate the top of the cafe counter.
[*] Added the option to decorate the sides of the cafe counter with small "wall" objects (e.g., calendar, sticky notes…).
[*] Items that cannot be placed will now turn red for better clarity.
[*] Fixed issues that allowed placing items outside of designated rooms.
[/list]

[b][h3]New Sandbox items:[/h3][/b] (Included in Playtest version)
[list]
[*] More carpets (+20)
[*] Simple shelves (+12)
[*] Little Creatures (+4)
[*] Coffee cups and brewing items (+14)
[*] Colorful sticky notes (+7)
[*] Vertical book stacks (+2)
[*] [b]Total new items: 59[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha Access!
notes.content:

notes.title: Devlog #008 (Feb 2025)
notes.content:
[h3][b]Game is expanding![/b][/h3]
Gameplay has been expanded with a new shop and order system, completed major NPC customers, and a skill tree that lets you customize your coffee-making experience! The first alpha version is approaching quickly, with an estimated release at the end of March as planned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/27f7fa0e7d6cecf00f2a37a7ccb91c54b0fa1201.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Shop & Orders[/b][/h3]
[i](Functional! UI design in progress..)[/i]

The new shop system has finally arrived, making your shopping experience much more interactive! While the initial design only allowed for immediate one  by one purchases, the new system lets players view current inventory counts, buy in bulk, and filter through all available items. After making your selections, you'll place a package order that takes some time to be delivered.

And yes, you can now finally sell your items, too! Especially if you're tired of that boring free chair you got at the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/f387712167f6b186c306b4625838bea9caa4fc12.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Skill tree[/b][/h3]
To add a layer of strategy to coffee making while keeping it simple, a skill tree has been introduced! As you level up and earn skill points, you’ll be able to unlock new coffee recipes, increase the XP gained from them, reduce brewing and grinding times, and gain other bonuses.

While you can’t unlock all skills at once, you’ll have the option to reset them anytime, allowing you to refine your own perfect brewing experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/a3ff508348ab07c6858cd3fde29e9c473b4999e0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/75e60fbc628f3fcc4355118d1e7da14eaca5e78f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ NPC Customer System [/b][/h3]
Last time, we mentioned adding big NPCs as customers to the café, and since then, this feature has been completed, with new characters now fully imported!

The number of customers depends on your level and the availability of chairs. To add more structure to the decoration system, chairs can now only be placed next to tables. While NPCs aren’t interactable just yet, I have some fun ideas for future improvements, maybe even making you eagerly anticipate visits from your favorite characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/b888bfdc18c5948a6291661fea4a241134e3b883.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Decor expansion[/b][/h3]
Decor item assets up to level 30 have been completed and are ready to be implemented in the game! This means players can now level up to 30 instead of being limited to 10. The current goal is to expand the game further, eventually reaching level 50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/384c0920c64d9b96c65c431597a098e8e0770225.png[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Completed 8/8 drinks[/b][/h3]
The planned eight drink recipes have now been added, expanding the game from the original three coffee drinks to a total of eight, along with a few related minigames!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/765b3f5ca5d6beed48bf608bfd3146593e93f269.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛠️ [b]Other edits & fixes:[/b][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug not allowing to proceed with dialogues at the introduction
[*] Added "Save & Exit" options when exiting the game or to the main menu
[*] Fixed money additions showing "+0"
[*] Gameplay increase to level 30 from 10
[*] Slight UI adjustments of level and time info for better visibility
[*] New NPC introduction dialogue added
[*] Fixed hovering over empty milk showing full milk sprite
[*] Fixed no orders showing but still gaining money and experience while completing some drinks
[*] Added setting to choose day length
[*] Added current item orders & skills to save system
[*] Fixed the layering issue of plants appearing on top of NPCs when placed on tables
[/list]

notes.title: Devlog #007 (Dec-Jan 2024)
notes.content:
[h3][b]After the long December holidays and an even longer January, development on Tailside is back with further updates![/b][/h3]
While the holiday season served as a rest period for the team, progress continued with new features and further work on the first private alpha version, to be tested together with fundraiser participants. The project remains on track to release the alpha version in Q1 of this year. As of this writing, the alpha version is approximately 60% complete. Here's an overview of the latest progress:

[h3][b]☕️ Completed Bedroom Addition[/b][/h3]
The bedroom area has been completed, featuring its own soundtrack. This will be the place to relax and prepare for a new workday. And yes, it can be decorated too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/03aa74b2c80e668d50280625e0b17ae32da76a97.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Completed Day & Night System[/b][/h3]
Alongside the bedroom, the day & night system is now fully implemented. At the end of each day, a summary will display key statistics and bonuses earned throughout the work hours.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/0bf8ef5764e726697998e517eb95e627ca936224.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ UI and Game Animation Polishing[/b][/h3]
Between other tasks, additional polishing touches are being tested for the UI and game animations to improve responsiveness and overall usability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/16b77a4a3749291ebc61ffc153b08fdc90020fe2.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/c081e01cc8403aa12725e890b0aaa7392c24a6a0.gif[/img] 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/2e74e76800c6602b2bc21a47683f496da970be22.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Completed Save & Load System[/b][/h3]
A save & load system is now fully functional, offering three save slots for creating different café experiences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/3c5d35379604a23804b92a6d2fbb4bf908938faa.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Ongoing Work on NPC Customer System[/b][/h3]
One of the largest features currently in development is the NPC customer system. While tiny customers were already present, friendly villager NPCs will soon begin visiting as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/f80b25b9190a3c8d761fbc1c8f10b037d33b5f81.gif[/img]

[h3][b]☕️ Localization Volunteering[/b][/h3]
Though not initially planned, localization may be added with the help of volunteers. Efforts are underway to make Tailside more accessible to non-English-speaking players.

Anyone interested in contributing can [url=https://forms.gle/x3S6nqeqrB1cEASf6]fill out this form with their native language.[/url]. We appreciate all the effort the community is putting into this!

[h3][b]☕️ Soundtrack DLC[/b][/h3]
The first set of soundtracks featured in early access has been completed, and the soundtrack DLC is now ready for setup. Fundraiser participants will receive the soundtrack before the game's release.

[h3][b]☕️ Custom Character Import[/b][/h3]
The main character is fully customizable! The alpha version will allow testing of the custom character import system, enabling players to personalize their protagonist for a more unique experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/510075eb46f58f5d157a6e09c0bd2894e04315c0.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛠️ [b]Other edits & fixes:[/b][/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed zoom issues on UI elements
[*] Fixed zoom in/out functionality in windowed mode when the mouse is not over the game
[*] Latte art mini-game now supports controllers and full keyboard input
[*] Fixed an NPC not appearing when "Skip Introduction" is activated
[*] Fixed orders not being enabled after dialogue ends
[*] Recipe book now opens automatically when introduced for the first time
[*] Fixed "End of Playtest" and the final task of the game
[*] Added a text UI animation displaying money increases and decreases
[*] Added a text UI animation showing experience gain
[*] Placing items now includes a small bounce animation
[*] Improved level-up UI animations to showcase new unlocked items one by one
[*] Fixed an issue preventing empty cups from being cleaned after the café closes
[*] Fixed some inventory items not displaying their quantities
[/list]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/3Q9WJ2V7bA]Discord[/url] | [url=https://x.com/CoffeeBeansDev]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/coffeebeansdev/]Instagram[/url] | [url=https://forms.gle/56vRkPBoaJ1Vshuh7]Leave your own suggestions[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #006 (Oct-Nov 2024)
notes.content:
🏆 [b]Highlight of Oct-Nov: Fundraiser wrap up[/b]
Tailside has been funded for it's EA launch with fundraiser raising over [b]40.000 EUR[/b] to make it happen! From a total of [b]900+ Backers[/b] there is now also around [b]110 custom items[/b] expected to be added to the game from cute little pastries to NPCs. All with a purpose in the game to improve the interactibility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/ff4d378de7eb16758fcc915064c432eebda68b36.png[/img]

Now, even more exciting news. During the fundraiser we had various stretch goals to reach to expand Tailside with new features and we have reached quite a few of them. Here are the list of stretch goals that community has funded and that are now guaranteed to be added in the Early Access launch:

[b]Sandbox mode:[/b]
This mode unlocks endless possibilities for players to decorate multiple cafes with no restrictions. Design your perfect cafe, share it with friends and fellow cafe owners. Should we feature the best ones?

[b]Cafe Terrace area:[/b]
The cafe terrace expansion adds a beautiful customizable outdoor area where customers can sip coffee under the sun, enjoy a scenic view, and experience a whole new feeling.

[b]Plushie Decor Set:[/b]
Transform your cafe into the ultimate cozy haven with an exclusive Plushie Decor Set or use it to decorate your own personal bedroom space! This collection of cozy plushies adds a warm, welcoming touch, creating the perfect place for customers and yourself to relax and enjoy.

[b]Greenhouse:[/b]
Grow and process your own coffee ingredients, buy mysterious seeds and discover new plants. These can be used to decorate your cafe or even become part of your cafe’s revenue - if your customers are interested in taking home a beautiful plant of their own.

[b]Soundtrack DLC:[/b]
Original Tailside soundtrack DLC will be produced and added as a free reward for all backers. Experience the cozy ambiance of Tailside cafe wherever you are! This exclusive Soundtrack DLC offers backers a collection of relaxing, heartwarming tunes straight from the game.

[b]Twitch integration:[/b]
Make your cafe even more interactive with Twitch integration! This feature allows players streaming on Twitch to interact directly with their viewers. Fullfil orders of the viewers, get extra coins, rewards and more.

[b]🏆 30.000 Wishlists milestone![/b]
During the fundraiser event, Tailside has reached a total of 30.000 wishlists, can't believe how many of you have Tailside in your lists of games you have at least a little bit of interest


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/3016b8cf2e671ad7d102204186401c159edd9644.gif[/img]

[b]On these great notes,[/b] the Early Access version development has already started and here's some overview on the current work through the initial EA features before moving to the unlocked fundraiser stretch goals:

[b]☕️ Day and night cycle[/b]
Gameplay is now expanding into Day & Night and weekdays cycle. With that we are adding more brewing involvement through timed bonuses and other mini games, on-work and off-work hours to differentiate the time between work and relaxation such as decoration your cafe, bedroom and terrace zones.

[b]☕️ New NPCs revealed[/b]
There will be a total of 10 NPCs to meet in the EA version, plus a few visitors by the fundraiser backer NPCs. All the designs of the 10 NPCs have been finalized and are currently going through animation process.

[b]☕️ New Original Soundtracks in production + Soundtrack DLC in plans:[/b]
The Original Soundtrack for Tailside already started production early November and currently we have a total of 7 tracks to be included in the game and Soundtrack DLC. This is expected to continue expand.

[b]☕️ Game decorations already reached over 100 items[/b]
For EA, there is around 200 items promised as decor for your cafe zones and we are moving fast to reaching it - there's already over 100 items done for you to discover.

[b]☕️ Keybinding & Controller Support[/b]
Added keybinding for keyboard & mouse and gamepad gameplay controls. Gamepad option is currently in testing and will be coming to EA.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/8a7475c431d48861f20a338432db2a17212b34b9.png[/img]

🛠️ [b]Other edits & fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Closing and opening the brewing panel will now continue with the progress that was left instead of restarting completely
[*] Skip to LV10 (Skip introduction) has been added
[*] Time and day system has been added
[*] Cafe working hours has been added
[*] Settings option to toggle between run/walk instead of holding down the button
[*] Added soundtracks between different zones and different times of the day
[*] Started adding some more UI animations to make it feel more immersive and interactive
[*] In build mode, hovered on items will now have an outline for better visibility
[*] Settings option to turn off camera motion following
[*] Latte challenge mode toggle moved to settings
[*] Latte art is now randomized to 3 selectable options for each latte order
[*] Some timed and goal activities for brewing has been added (top secret!)
[*] Build mode fixing to work between different scenes and zones so you can decorate accordingly
[*] Expanding recipe book with other features
[*] Adding new journal for tracking game progress, levels, character info and more
[/list]

[b]If you would like to be part of the development journey,[/b] you can vote on various ideas on:
[url=https://discord.com/invite/3Q9WJ2V7bA]Discord[/url] | [url=https://x.com/CoffeeBeansDev]Twitter[/url] | [url=https://www.instagram.com/coffeebeansdev/]Instagram[/url] | [url=https://forms.gle/56vRkPBoaJ1Vshuh7]Leave your own suggestions[/url]
[i]Thank you so much for the support[/i] [b]- Coffee Beans Dev[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #005 (August 2024)
notes.content:
🎮 [b]A Month of Playtesting[/b]
August has been busy, with[b] two playtest versions[/b] released and lots of small and large bugs fixed. We are getting closer to the finalized demo version of the game. Current playtest access will remain open, and the third and[b] final playtest version is planned to be released in the first half of September.[/b]

🏆[b]First Event Results[/b]
We wrapped up the Wholesome Games week with [b]3,000 new wishlist additions[/b] and have been added to the recommended curated games, which has so far brought in an [b]additional 2,000 wishlists[/b], bringing us to [b]over 18,000 total wishlists[/b] at the time of this post! [b]Our coffee & cozy games community just keeps growing.[/b]

🎁[b]Upcoming fundraiser[/b]
The next exciting step for Tailside is our [b]upcoming fundraiser launch[/b]! This campaign will help us cover [b]development costs[/b] until [b]Early Access[/b] and may even allow us to add some extra features through stretch goals. As a special thank you for your early support, [b]our fundraiser will feature an exclusive woodland-themed decor set, pet, and main character color[/b]—available only through this campaign.

📓 [b]Let's Recap a Month of Work[/b]
Here is a recap of everything that has been added and fixed during this month of playtesting:

☕️ [b]Recipe book[/b]
Added a recipe book to review various coffee-making steps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/37ea5f1b4b19eeeb881c74609585b4240e858845.gif[/img]

☕️ [b]More guidance[/b]
Mini tutorials and notes for better guidance through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/97da8b88b82f9ce678b58cfb772768bf09e202cb.gif[/img]

☕️ [b]Partial settings[/b]
Several settings related to music and dialogue adjustments have been added.

☕️ [b]Improved customer system[/b]
Customers now enter with a coin, place a coffee order, take it, and leave a bit of a mess (empty cups) around. Tiny customers might jump on the tables if there is space!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/afca3e4c14016146f475adfe552b07127f2660fc.gif[/img]

☕️ [b]Improved build/decor system[/b]
Build mode now has an option to toggle grid snap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/c6191c203c0acc93f5bd674a427ce49a66c7f208.gif[/img]

Items will now be placed as previewed rather than "dropping down."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/69fc2a112e63f4624549d1f15b7d5109d4a0f842.gif[/img]

☕️ [b]Quicker coffee making[/b]
Separated the grinding, brewing, and milk heating processes so that all of them can be done simultaneously.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/dc441544a0fbeecdd9dc054700a86c4767cbba0b.gif[/img]

☕️ [b]New mini-game: Drawing latte art[/b]
The first version of the latte art mini-game will be added to the next playtest version. There will also be an option to enable or disable the scoring bonus depending on your challenge preference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/95b183fb24e1ab237c794bebd82c263027291db7.gif[/img]

☕️ [b]More cafe management:[/b]
Coffee bean sorting will now be done periodically once the coffee beans bar decreases. The mess of empty cups will now affect the number of customers coming to the café.

🛠️ [b]Other edits & fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor floor art fixes
[*] Added an exit button to the recipe book
[*] The recipe book will auto-close when the brewing panel is closed
[*] Character portraits will not be shown during brewing to avoid obscuring the view and buttons
[*] Empty cups now have a better indication for cleaning up
[*] Fixed customers not being triggered to enter the café on LV7
[*] Fixed moka pot floating out of position after shaking too much
[*] The order list now zooms in during brewing to make it more visible
[*] Fixed tooltip hover resolution issues
[*] Fixed a few dialogue lines
[*] Added build and shop icons to the build mode panel slips
[*] Cappuccino has been replaced with Macchiato, as Cappuccino will be available later on through more complicated brewing steps
[*] Edited some button click areas to make them feel more responsive
[*] Fixed dialogue mixing up if two dialogues are triggered at once
[*] Fixed build mode not showing during the package opening level
[*] Slightly edited the look of small cups to differentiate between small and large cups
[*] Dialogues are now skippable with a mouse click, not just with the space bar

[/list]
🌻 [b]Coming next:[/b]
[list]
[*] Third and final playtest version before official DEMO release (1st half of September)
[*] Game Trailer teaser
[*] Fundraiser event information release
[/list]

notes.title: Tailside in Wholesome Games
notes.content:
[i]It's only the beginning of the month and exciting news just keep rolling out.[/i]

☕️ I’m thrilled to announce that Tailside will be included in the [b]Wholesome Games[/b] event here on Steam from [b]August 15-21st[/b]!

Wholesome Games is an event that features world premiere game announcements, discounts, demos, and launches of new, heartwarming games worth checking out.

Tailside is a cozy café game that invites you to unwind with adorable animal characters, café decor, and coffee brewing. It’s the perfect stop to relax.

This event marks a significant milestone for Tailside as it’s our first official participation in a major gaming event. I believe this will be a great opportunity to expand our cozy community and share the charm of Tailside with more players.

During the Wholesome Games event, Tailside's playtest will be available for everyone to try out directly through Tailside's Steam page. Simply request access, and the game will appear in your library immediately.

☕️ [b]The playtest includes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Inside café area
[*] Coffee making
[*] Introduction of the first characters
[*] Café decoration options
[*] Tiny customers
[*] 10 levels
[*] 20 minutes of gameplay
[*] Plenty of hints for further updates
[/list]
My main goal for this event is to get more eyes on Tailside and see our community grow and get further feedback on the game itself. I’m incredibly excited to see how it goes and can’t wait to welcome all the new members joining us.

Stay tuned for more updates and be sure to join us during the Wholesome Games event!

notes.title: Devlog #001 (April 2024)
notes.content:
After achieveming a big milestone of [b]publishing the Steam page of Tailside[/b], [b]gathering 1000+ wishlists in 3 days[/b] and [b]2000+ within 2 weeks[/b], we are now ready to start publishing more of work and behind the scenes of [b]this little cozy cafe game[/b].

This month we started creating new artwork, scenes and dialogues to the introductionary story of Tailside and some improvements on current gameplay, here is a quick breakdown:

🌱 [b]Outside assets completed:[/b]
For your pleasure of wondering around the world of Tailside, we have completed art assets to start building the forests, trails and new scenes outside the cafe itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/e1260b72403ac311560a51343d272821ef680e41.png[/img]

🌱 [b]New campsite scene added:[/b]
Everyone loves a good camping evening with shared stories and nicely cooked marshmallows. It's probably a place you will keep finding yourself in with your newly made friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/6ce9b2dd139addc7bad5a7e2e8b0abd33907f151.png[/img]

☕️ [b]Expanded build mode:[/b]
Build mode (cafe decoration) has now been expanded and split into shop + inventory system for a more convenient and organized way of purchasing decorations and making the cafe look the way you want it! Yes, it's fully customizable!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/e2c908b30e2d523e2465e28397e11c2c5d120e7c.png[/img]

🎨 [b]Collaboration of the month:[/b]
This month we have revealed a collaboration for decorative plant assets for your personalized cafe with [url=https://www.instagram.com/Grigoreen/]Grigoreen[/url]. These plants will be available in the cafe decoration shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44971355/ea3e57f446eb7aad6c2caa7abe0e43e23990506d.png[/img]

🛠️ [b]Minor edits:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed coffee brewing panel to have sized up view for better playability.
[/list]

🌻 [b]Coming next:[/b]
[list]
[*] Garden area (outside of cafe)
[*] Build mode expansion (decor categories)
[*] Coffee brewing improvements (upgrades)
[*] Better visuals with lightning and shadows for night and day moods!
[/list]
